Jonas / Maria —

Thanks for the clear list. I reviewed Acme's redlines and annotated the attached doc with suggested language. High-level points:

- Pricing / prepay discount: we will add an express sentence to the Pricing Appendix: "Prepay discounts apply solely to committed volumes as set forth in Section 2. Overage volumes will be billed at the published overage rates and are not eligible for prepay discounts." (see tracked changes).

- Minimum commit / true-up: legal is comfortable with a quarterly true-up. Proposed clause (1 line) inserted in the Payment Schedule: "If actual usage in any quarter exceeds committed volumes, Customer shall pay the incremental overage within 30 days of invoice; the Parties will reconcile committed volume true-ups on a quarterly basis." Please confirm if Acme needs the true-up window extended to 45 days for internal processing.

- Net terms: commercial recommends Net45 for enterprise procurement; commercial to confirm if Redwood can accept Net45 on this deal. If Net45, we will add system fields to ensure invoices are issued to the correct legal entity.

- Taxes / VAT: Ben, per standard practice we bill Redwood EMEA Ltd for EU/UK invoices and apply reverse-charge where Acme provides a valid VAT registration. If Acme cannot provide that, standard VAT will be charged. I attached a template tax certificate (Tax_Cert_Redwood.pdf) — Maria, please confirm Acme's VAT registration number and the billing entity.

I've attached Acme_OrderForm_v3_redline_KP.docx with comments and a one-page summary. Once we have confirmation on Net terms and the VAT registration, I'll finalize the redline.
